# Boom Length

> Estimate how much containment boom you need to encircle a slick or deflect oil across a current, then train your crew on booms, spill kits and oil spill response.

Boom Length (https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Spill Prevention & Response training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing spills and the first response. Enroll: https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416

## Guides

- [Deploying boom in moving water](https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/guides/deploying-boom-in-moving-water): Angles, anchors and collection points for creeks, rivers and channels.
- [Why boom fails](https://boom-calculator.hazwoperosha.us/guides/why-boom-fails): Five ways oil gets past containment boom.
